notes: I changed the model from predicting nothing to a piecewise rule: the box returns 1 on the small interval {-1, 0, 1} and 0 everywhere else, based on E1 where only x = -1, 0, 1 gave 1 while -2 and 2 gave 0. The exact interval boundaries are uncertain (marked with "?"), so I used the observed nonzero points as the interval.
